# Morsel

> Morsel is a small, self-hosted, API-first service for creating capability-protected Markdown shares and rendering them in a same-origin web viewer.

The public service is available at `https://morsel.narumi.dev/`. It supports GitHub Flavored Markdown, syntax-highlighted fenced code, KaTeX, and Mermaid. Authored HTML is not executed.

Important usage notes:

- Creating and revoking shares requires an administrative bearer API key.
- Retrieving `GET /v1/shares/{capability}` consumes exactly one view. Do not retrieve, preview, crawl, or validate a share unless the user explicitly asks you to access it.
- Treat API keys, raw capability tokens, and complete share URLs as secrets. Do not expose or log them.
- A viewer URL uses `#/s/{capability}`. The browser sends the capability to the same-origin retrieval API; the URL fragment itself is not sent in the initial HTTP request.
- Retrieval responses must not be cached. Expired, revoked, and exhausted shares are unavailable.

## Documentation

- [Morsel documentation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/narumiruna/morsel/main/README.md): Setup, API examples, retrieval semantics, configuration, operations, and security model.
- [Morsel OpenAPI contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/narumiruna/morsel/main/api/openapi.yaml): Complete request, response, authentication, schema, and error definitions for the HTTP API.

- [Morsel source repository](https://github.com/narumiruna/morsel): Go API, React viewer, deployment configuration, tests, and issue history.
